body: <sf-list-attention id="health"><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"items": [{"id": "backup", "status": "warning", "title": "Последняя копия demo-owned.test не удалась", "text": "27 октября, 03:30 · нет места на диске", "action": {"label": "Открыть копии", "href": "#backups"}}, {"id": "down", "status": "error", "title": "demo-php.test не отвечает", "text": "12 минут, код 502", "action": {"label": "Перезапустить", "event": "restart"}}, {"id": "cert", "status": "warning", "title": "Сертификат demo-static.test истекает через 6 дней", "action": {"label": "Продлить", "href": "#cert"}}, {"id": "update", "status": "info", "title": "Доступна панель 0.3.1", "text": "Изменения: журнал, резервные копии"}]}</script></sf-list-attention>

checks.title: the items are ordered error, warning, info in the host's order inside a status; the heading counts them and the section is named by it
checks.covers: settings.items, settings.label, settings.heading-level, accessibility.role region, host-states data-status

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#health'); const root = el.querySelector('section.sf-list-attention'); const heading = document.getElementById(root.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')); const ids = [...el.querySelectorAll('.sf-list-attention-item')].map((li) => li.dataset.id).join(','); return ids === 'down,backup,cert,update' && heading.getAttribute('role') === 'heading' && heading.getAttribute('aria-level') === '3' && heading.querySelector('.sf-list-attention-heading-text').textContent === 'Требует внимания' && heading.querySelector('.sf-list-attention-count').textContent.trim() === '4' && el.getAttribute('data-status') === 'error' && el.querySelector('.sf-list-attention-item .sr-only').textContent === 'Ошибка: '; })()

checks.title: an action with href is a link; its press asks sf-list-attention-navigate, cancelable
an action with event is a button; its press sends sf-list-attention-apply {action, scope entry, ids}
with no items it takes no room (empty none) or draws one quiet line (empty line); a new list draws again

steps.check: (() => { const none = document.querySelector('#none'); const quiet = document.querySelector('#quiet'); return none.getAttribute('data-empty') === 'true' && !none.querySelector('.sf-list-attention') && quiet.querySelector('.sf-list-attention-quiet').textContent.includes('Проверки пройдены') && quiet.querySelector('.sf-list-attention').getBoundingClientRect().height > 0; })()
